messages:
Hana: Quick doc request: add a tiny guidance section for "fallback models" in the Dedicated provisioning guide. Ops keep asking about SLA and billing when fallback is enabled. cc @kevin

Kevin: I can add a short example and a one-liner about SLA impact. Draft YAML: 
```yaml
reserved_capacity:
  gpus: 8
  model: rdl-xl-v1
scalePolicy:
  target_qps: 200
  cooldown_s: 90
  fallbackModel: rdl-large-q1
  fallback_policy:
    max_fallback_pct: 25
tenant_labels:
  isolation: low
```

SRE-Jen: Ops notes to include: (1) fallback is best-effort overflow and does NOT reduce guaranteed reserved throughput. (2) latency SLOs may differ for fallback requests.

Hana: Add a tiny CLI + SDK snippet and a troubleshooting FAQ: "Why did X% of traffic go to fallback?" -> explain max_fallback_pct + quota vs reserved limits.

docs-bot: Added draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4333 (WIP). Reviewers requested: @kevin @sre-jen

Kevin: Will review and merge if clean. Hana: can you include the internal SLA link in the PR text?

Hana: Done. Merging after Kevin's sign-off.
